title: Mainline publication candidate
source_of_truth: The repository. Every sha here is re-derived by the verifier from git; this file records which ones matter, not what is true.

lineage.baseline_rule: The Stage 10 merge commit is the publication baseline. It cannot be known from inside the branch that becomes it, so it is null here and recorded by whatever Dev Order comes next. Nothing flips a status afterwards.

certification.delegation: Publication does not re-derive certification. The verifier runs Stage 9's verifier and generator --check and reports what they say.

intervening_changes.what: register check fails only on what it can fix

full_pytest.failed_are: the two known Windows-only environment artifacts; Linux CI is authoritative

browser_reproducible.note: Re-run and compared against the Stage 9 artifact: identical apart from freshly generated session and attempt UUIDs. Final status, digests and canonical revision match. The artifact was restored; Stage 9's evidence is unchanged by this stage.

verification.stage10_base_enforcement: stage10_base_sha is checked against the branch point (git merge-base HEAD origin/main), not merely for presence or ancestry: every commit back to the certification is an ancestor, so ancestry alone would accept a base that misstates where publication was prepared from. Where no branch point can be determined -- once this merges, origin/main contains it -- the run says the field was not enforced rather than inventing a verdict.

tags.policy: An unexpected MVP 2 tag stops the stage and is reported, never removed.

known_limitations: DOM rendering is not certified: no connected browser was available, so there is no visual witness and no screenshots.
Node has no Linux CI coverage; the Node suite is certified on Windows only.
The reproducible browser witness mirrors the Stage 2 lifecycle in JavaScript. Lifecycle truth, transition truth and the session digest are certified separately through the real Stage 4 API.
VIEW_ONE_STRING and ENABLE_ZONE_VIEW have no natural browser witness and remain covered by unit and Stage 8 tests.
deferred_work: Stage 8 crosswalk verifier checks citation shape, not semantic target meaning.
Line-number citations are fragile; symbol-based path::name references are preferred future hardening.
Adversarial tests import private helpers from another test module; future test-maintenance coupling.
Neither check_in_flight.py nor verify_do015_certification.py is a CI gate: verify.yml is a deferred-hygiene path frozen by DO-012A and unfreezing it needs an owner ruling.
not_claimed: MVP 2 is not released, not tagged and not complete.
Publication has not happened: the owner's merge is the publication event.
No learner-facing behaviour changed in this stage.
DOM rendering remains uncertified; the Stage 9 limitations carry forward unrepaired.
